reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V4: linear-ST steady-state (openpilot-prior C_af/C_ar per platform, matching agent's V3 fit which returned priors) + per-segment straight-line bias correction + first-order yaw-rate lag tau=0.08s, with KS fallback below v=2 m/s.
notes: Agent's V4 favourite: linear-ST steady-state (per-platform priors; agent's L-BFGS-B fit on Mach-E returned priors unchanged) + per-segment straight-line bias correction (whole-seg mean fallback) + first-order yaw-rate lag tau=0.08s, KS fallback at v<2 m/s. Agent only evaluated on Mach-E (315 seg); we apply the same algorithm with each platform's openpilot priors to the F-150 Lightning too.
